check('order kept', lambda: parallel_map(lambda x: x * x, range(6)), [0, 1, 4, 9, 16, 25])
check('empty', lambda: parallel_map(str, []), [])
check('strings', lambda: parallel_map(str.upper, ["a", "b"]), ['A', 'B'])
check('is concurrent', lambda: (lambda s: (parallel_map(lambda _: time.sleep(0.2), range(4), workers=4), time.perf_counter() - s < 0.6)[1])(time.perf_counter()), True)
check('error propagates', lambda: raises(lambda: parallel_map(lambda x: 1 / x, [1, 0]), ZeroDivisionError), True)
check('one worker', lambda: parallel_map(abs, [-1, -2], workers=1), [1, 2])

check('mixed', lambda: run_jobs({"b": lambda: 2, "a": lambda: 1 / 0, "c": lambda: "ok"}), ({'b': 2, 'c': 'ok'}, {'a': 'ZeroDivisionError: division by zero'}))
check('all ok', lambda: run_jobs({"x": lambda: 1}), ({'x': 1}, {}))
check('empty', lambda: run_jobs({}), ({}, {}))
check('all fail', lambda: run_jobs({"k": lambda: {}["missing"], "v": lambda: int("x")}), ({}, {'k': "KeyError: 'missing'", 'v': "ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'x'"}))
check('none result', lambda: run_jobs({"n": lambda: None}), ({'n': None}, {}))
check('slow and fast', lambda: run_jobs({"slow": lambda: time.sleep(0.1) or "s", "fast": lambda: "f"}), ({'fast': 'f', 'slow': 's'}, {}))

check('exact', lambda: locked_total(4, 2500), 10000)
check('one thread', lambda: locked_total(1, 10), 10)
check('no threads', lambda: locked_total(0, 100), 0)
check('no increments', lambda: locked_total(3, 0), 0)
check('many threads', lambda: locked_total(16, 100), 1600)
check('repeatable', lambda: len({locked_total(4, 500) for _ in range(3)}), 1)

check('small', lambda: sum_squares_queue([1, 2, 3]), 14)
check('range', lambda: sum_squares_queue(range(100)), 328350)
check('empty', lambda: sum_squares_queue([]), 0)
check('one consumer', lambda: sum_squares_queue([4, 5], consumers=1), 41)
check('more consumers than items', lambda: sum_squares_queue([7], consumers=8), 49)
check('generator', lambda: sum_squares_queue(x for x in range(1000)), 332833500)

check('even', lambda: chunk_ranges(10, 2), [(0, 5), (5, 10)])
check('uneven', lambda: chunk_ranges(10, 3), [(0, 4), (4, 7), (7, 10)])
check('more workers than items', lambda: chunk_ranges(2, 4), [(0, 1), (1, 2)])
check('zero', lambda: chunk_ranges(0, 3), [])
check('one worker', lambda: chunk_ranges(5, 1), [(0, 5)])
check('covers all', lambda: sum(b - a for a, b in chunk_ranges(1001, 7)), 1001)

check('order', lambda: run(fetch_all([3, 1, 2], lambda i: sleepy(0.01 * i, i * 10))), [30, 10, 20])
check('empty', lambda: run(fetch_all([], lambda i: sleepy(0, i))), [])
check('strings', lambda: run(fetch_all(["a"], lambda s: sleepy(0, s.upper()))), ['A'])
check('concurrent', lambda: (lambda s: (run(fetch_all(range(10), lambda i: sleepy(0.2, i))), time.perf_counter() - s < 0.8)[1])(time.perf_counter()), True)
check('error propagates', lambda: raises(lambda: run(fetch_all([1], lambda i: sleepy(0, 1 / 0))), ZeroDivisionError), True)
check('probe', lambda: run(fetch_all([1, 2], Probe().call)), [2, 4])

check('results', lambda: run(map_limited(Probe().call, range(5), 2)), [0, 2, 4, 6, 8])
check('peak respected', lambda: (lambda p: (run(map_limited(p.call, range(20), 3)), p.peak)[1])(Probe()), 3)
check('limit one is sequential', lambda: (lambda p: (run(map_limited(p.call, range(5), 1)), p.peak)[1])(Probe()), 1)
check('empty', lambda: run(map_limited(Probe().call, [], 4)), [])
check('limit above items', lambda: (lambda p: (run(map_limited(p.call, range(3), 10)), p.peak)[1])(Probe()), 3)
check('all called', lambda: (lambda p: (run(map_limited(p.call, range(7), 2)), p.calls)[1])(Probe()), 7)

check('fast', lambda: run(with_timeout(sleepy(0.01, "ok"), 1)), 'ok')
check('slow', lambda: run(with_timeout(sleepy(1, "late"), 0.05, "fallback")), 'fallback')
check('default none', lambda: run(with_timeout(sleepy(1, 1), 0.05)), None)
check('returns quickly', lambda: (lambda s: (run(with_timeout(sleepy(5, 1), 0.1)), time.perf_counter() - s < 1)[1])(time.perf_counter()), True)
check('errors propagate', lambda: raises(lambda: run(with_timeout(sleepy(0, 1 / 0), 1)), ZeroDivisionError), True)
check('zero result kept', lambda: run(with_timeout(sleepy(0, 0), 1, -1)), 0)

check('ok', lambda: run(fetch_strict([1, 2, 3], lambda i: sleepy(0.01, i * i))), [1, 4, 9])
check('empty', lambda: run(fetch_strict([], lambda i: sleepy(0, i))), [])
check('group raised', lambda: type(caught(lambda: run(fetch_strict([1, 0], lambda i: sleepy(0, 1 / i))))).__name__, 'ExceptionGroup')
check('member type', lambda: [type(e).__name__ for e in caught(lambda: run(fetch_strict([0], lambda i: sleepy(0, 1 / i)))).exceptions], ['ZeroDivisionError'])
check('order', lambda: run(fetch_strict([3, 1, 2], lambda i: sleepy(0.01 * i, i))), [3, 1, 2])
check('cancels slow siblings', lambda: (lambda s: (caught(lambda: run(fetch_strict([0, 1], lambda i: sleepy(5 * i, 1 / i)))), time.perf_counter() - s < 2)[1])(time.perf_counter()), True)

check('doubles', lambda: run(process_all([3, 1, 2], 2, Probe().call)), [2, 4, 6])
check('empty', lambda: run(process_all([], 3, Probe().call)), [])
check('peak is workers', lambda: (lambda p: (run(process_all(range(12), 3, p.call)), p.peak)[1])(Probe()), 3)
check('one worker', lambda: (lambda p: (run(process_all(range(4), 1, p.call)), p.peak)[1])(Probe()), 1)
check('strings', lambda: run(process_all(["b", "a"], 2, lambda s: sleepy(0, s * 2))), ['aa', 'bb'])
check('count', lambda: len(run(process_all(range(50), 5, Probe(0).call))), 50)

check('results', lambda: run(run_blocking([lambda: 1, lambda: "two"])), [1, 'two'])
check('empty', lambda: run(run_blocking([])), [])
check('concurrent', lambda: (lambda s: (run(run_blocking([lambda: time.sleep(0.2)] * 3)), time.perf_counter() - s < 0.5)[1])(time.perf_counter()), True)
check('runs in threads', lambda: len(set(run(run_blocking([lambda: (time.sleep(0.05), threading.get_ident())[1]] * 3)))) > 1, True)
check('error propagates', lambda: raises(lambda: run(run_blocking([lambda: {}['x']])), KeyError), True)
check('order', lambda: run(run_blocking([lambda: (time.sleep(0.1), 'slow')[1], lambda: 'fast'])), ['slow', 'fast'])

check('burst then deny', lambda: (lambda t: (lambda b: [b.allow() for _ in range(4)])(TokenBucket(1, 3, lambda: t[0])))([0.0]), [True, True, True, False])
check('refill', lambda: (lambda t: (lambda b: [b.allow(), b.allow(), t.__setitem__(0, 1.0), b.allow(), b.allow()])(TokenBucket(1, 1, lambda: t[0])))([0.0]), [True, False, None, True, False])
check('capped at capacity', lambda: (lambda t: (lambda b: [b.allow(), t.__setitem__(0, 100.0), sum(b.allow() for _ in range(5))][2])(TokenBucket(1, 2, lambda: t[0])))([0.0]), 2)
check('fractional rate', lambda: (lambda t: (lambda b: [b.allow(), t.__setitem__(0, 1.0), b.allow(), t.__setitem__(0, 2.0), b.allow()])(TokenBucket(0.5, 1, lambda: t[0])))([0.0]), [True, None, False, None, True])
check('high rate', lambda: (lambda t: (lambda b: [sum(b.allow() for _ in range(10)), t.__setitem__(0, 0.5), sum(b.allow() for _ in range(10))][::2])(TokenBucket(10, 5, lambda: t[0])))([0.0]), [5, 5])
check('thread safe', lambda: (lambda b: sum(ThreadPoolExecutor(8).map(lambda _: b.allow(), range(200))))(TokenBucket(0, 50, lambda: 0.0)), 50)

check('fastest wins', lambda: (first_result([lambda: (time.sleep(0.3), "slow")[1], lambda: (time.sleep(0.01), "fast")[1]])), 'fast')
check('skips failures', lambda: first_result([lambda: 1 / 0, lambda: (time.sleep(0.05), "ok")[1]]), 'ok')
check('single', lambda: first_result([lambda: 42]), 42)
check('all fail', lambda: raises(lambda: first_result([lambda: 1 / 0, lambda: {}['k']]), Exception), True)
check('returns early', lambda: (lambda s: (first_result([lambda: time.sleep(1.5), lambda: 'quick']), time.perf_counter() - s < 1)[1])(time.perf_counter()), True)
check('empty raises', lambda: raises(lambda: first_result([]), ValueError), True)
